d: Mokama ke purv vidhayak anant sinh apni beti ki aagami shadi ki bhavy taiyariyon ko lekar ek bar phir jabardast surkhiyon men hain. shadi ke nimantran kard ko midiya ke samne dikhate hue unhonne ailan kiya hai ki ve paksh-vipaksh ke sabhi chhote-bare netaon ke sath-sath apne tamam doston aur chahne valon ko shadi ka nyota denge.
